name: What should I prepare before a glazing upgrade installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a glazing upgrade installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a glazing upgrade installation, you should clear obstructions from around your windows, both inside and out. This includes moving furniture, removing window treatments, and clearing any outdoor landscaping or décor that might impede access. We also recommend securing pets and protecting valuables near the windows. Our team will provide a detailed checklist during the pre-installation walkthrough, ensuring your home in locations like Piedmont or Pleasanton is ready for a smooth process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear obstructions around windows, move furniture, remove window treatments, secure pets, and protect valuables. A checklist will be provided during a pre-installation walkthrough.
